description: This file contains a stub implementation for the Rialto Session Server used in testing. It defines a Service class that simulates server responses, manages client connections, and provides methods to send events and disconnect clients, primarily for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: A mock service class inheriting from rialto::ServerManagerModule, used to simulate server responses for testing.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Callback function invoked when a client disconnects, logs client process and user IDs.

methods.name: RialtoSessionServerStub
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket pairs and server factory, setting up the stub environment.

methods.name: ~RialtoSessionServerStub
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up client connections, threads, and resetting resources.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server stub with a specified response, sets up client, and runs server processing in a thread.

methods.name: getClientSocket
methods.description: Returns the socket descriptor for the client connection.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event to the client indicating the server state.

methods.name: sendAckEvent
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment event with a ping ID and success status.
